build_observed.diagnostic: CS1061 Dictionary<string,int> has no accessible GetValueOrDefault extension method
build_observed.static_explanation: The file imports Godot, System, IO, Linq, Text.Json and Simulation, but not System.Collections.Generic. Game csproj does not enable ImplicitUsings and no Game global generic-collections using was found. Installed net10.0 reference XML declares the intended method as System.Collections.Generic.CollectionExtensions.GetValueOrDefault. These observations strongly support a missing namespace import at the new calls; no source edit or confirming rebuild performed.
